extDesc.message: Blur candidate name, photo, pronouns and school on LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever and Indeed. Reduce first-pass bias. On-device, private.

heroSub.message: Names & photos blur before a card renders.

siteNone.message: Open a candidate list on LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever or Indeed

demoHint.message: This is exactly what BlindPass does on LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever & Indeed. Use the toggle above to blur every candidate; click an eye to reveal one.

optSub.message: Blind first-pass screening on LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever & Indeed.

syncNoteFree.message: On Pro, your ~300-byte config syncs automatically across your signed-in Chrome profiles.

strictNote.message: Strict mode is on: if a card is detected but a field can't be located, BlindPass blurs the whole card header rather than risk showing a name. It over-blurs, never leaks.

upgradeSub.message: Pronouns, school & grad-year, blur styles, shortcut, per-site control, scorecard and sync — one payment, lifetime.

obLede.message: BlindPass blurs candidate name and photo the instant a card renders on LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever and Indeed — so your first pass is genuinely blind. Nothing ever leaves your computer.

obDemoSub.message: A mock candidate list — no recruiter site needed. Toggle blind mode and watch identity disappear before you read a word.

obDemoHint.message: Skills stay sharp. Click the eye to reveal one candidate when you're ready to shortlist — reveals never persist, so a reload re-blinds everyone.

obStep1Note.message: Name and photo are masked by CSS the instant a candidate card mounts — there's no flash of identity to un-see.

obStep2Note.message: Decided to shortlist? Click the eye on that card to reveal just that one. Everyone else stays blind.

obStep3Note.message: If a page redesign hides a field, BlindPass over-blurs the card header rather than risk exposing a name.

obFree1.message: Blur name & photo on all three sites

obCtaSub.message: Open a candidate list on LinkedIn Recruiter, Lever or Indeed — names and photos are already blurred. Manage everything from the toolbar icon.
